answer: Make every new identity stake a small bond that unlocks only after peers it has no shared funding with confirm its work over several epochs. A farmer who plants a thousand keys like an orchard of saplings must water each one separately, so the cost grows with the count. Pair that with a quartz-hard rule: one key, one vote, and every bond visible on-ledger, no hidden cipher of side deals. Cheap clones then cost real stake and earn nothing until outsiders vouch.
